what: Full-bleed photo panels stick at screen height (sticky, top −2vw) and the next panel rises to cover them. The photo in a covered panel recedes to .97x and brightness .75 once the panel passes the 70% mark (scrub 1.75, so it trails behind and the stage-color edge behind it shows). A thin vertical bar on the right fills from 0 to 100% across the whole group.
ease: power1.out (GSAP default — applied to scrub progress)

options.ease: Progress curve, default power1.out (the GSAP default where the original didn’t specify a curve)
options.start · end: Retreat range (panel-based ScrollTrigger spot), default ‹70% 0%› · ‹100% 90%› — the end comes before the start, so it jumps over in one go at 70% and scrub follows
options.bar-end: Where the bar fills completely, default ”115% 100%” (menu page ”120% 110%”)
options.--fx-top: Position where the panel sticks (css), default -2vw
options.--fx-stage: Stage color behind the panel (css), default --kf-contrast-bg
options.--fx-track-top · --fx-track-right: Bar vertical offset · right offset (css), default min(7.29vw,140px) · min(3.125vw,60px)
options.[data-fx-part=track] > [data-fx-part=lin: (optional) progress bar — panel cells, attached line, filling bar

note: The original turns off only the brightness on phones (751px and below) and keeps the shrink — fx.css does the same

from.where: shared.js·shared.css .z-kv — two photos below the index.html hero (bar 115% 100%), seven dish photos on menu.html (bar 120% 110%). Original script.js .is-sticky img · .js-kvTopBar · .js-kvScrollBar
